claims.text: The Manor sits on the green, rolling hills south of the Ngorongoro Crater, reached by crossing the Rift Valley.

findings.quote: Crossing the Rift Valley and climbing the steppe onto the green and rolling hills south of the Ngorongoro Crater

claims.text: The Manor is located adjacent to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, in north west Tanzania.

claims.text: The Manor stands within a 1500-acre Arabica coffee estate.

claims.text: The lodge blends East African hospitality with old-world Afro-European architecture and decor.

claims.text: Accommodation is in cottages, including a family cottage, alongside a main Manor House.
